name: Excelsior Scholarship
organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
description: Tuition-free attendance at SUNY or CUNY two- or four-year colleges for full-time New York students whose household federal adjusted gross income is $125,000 or less. Students must complete 30 credits per year and live and work in New York after graduation for the length of the award.
_quarantineReason: NY Excelsior 2026-27 cycle closed on hesc.ny.gov; next cycle deadline not published. Re-add when HESC posts 2027-28 dates.

name: NYS Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM) Incentive Program
organization: New York State Higher Education Services Corporation (HESC)
description: Full SUNY or CUNY tuition for students in the top 10 percent of their New York high school class who pursue an approved STEM degree at a SUNY or CUNY college and agree to work in a STEM field in New York State for five years after graduation.
_quarantineReason: NYS STEM Incentive 2026-27 deadline was 2026-08-15 (dataset had 08-31, wrong); cycle closed, next not published.

name: William A. Crawford Minority Teacher Scholarship
description: For Black and Hispanic/Latino Indiana students pursuing teaching. Recipients agree to apply for and, if hired, teach in an Indiana accredited school for at least three years. Requires full-time enrollment and a valid FAFSA.
_quarantineReason: Indiana CHE page still shows the expired 2026-08-31 ScholarTrack deadline; next cycle not published.

name: Lilly Endowment Community Scholarship
organization: Lilly Endowment Inc. / Independent Colleges of Indiana
amountLabel: Full tuition, fees + up to $900/yr books
description: One of Indiana's most prestigious awards, providing full tuition, required fees, and up to $900 per year for books for four years at any eligible Indiana college. Awarded to graduating seniors in each of Indiana's 92 counties through local community foundations; criteria and deadlines vary by county.
_quarantineReason: Lilly Endowment confirms deadlines are set by each county community foundation; no single national date exists.

name: Tennessee HOPE Scholarship
description: Tennessee Education Lottery merit scholarship for residents attending eligible in-state colleges. Freshmen and sophomores receive up to 2,250 dollars per semester, juniors and seniors up to 2,850 dollars. Requires a 21 ACT or 1060 SAT, or a weighted 3.0 GPA, and one year of Tennessee residency.
_quarantineReason: Duplicate of id 200 (Tennessee HOPE Scholarship). Merged into 200.

name: Jump Start Scholarship
description: For South Dakota residents who attended a South Dakota public high school full-time for at least two semesters and graduate in three years or less. Pays $1,500 split across fall and spring of the first year at an accredited South Dakota postsecondary institution. Students who enroll in a fourth year of high school are ineligible.
_quarantineReason: SD Jump Start has no published student deadline (10/1 and 2/25 are institutional roster dates).

name: South Dakota Needs-Based Scholarship Grant
description: Grant for South Dakota resident students with demonstrated unmet financial need attending a public university in the state. Requires completion of the FAFSA. Award ranges from $500 to $2,000 depending on need.
_quarantineReason: SD Needs-Based has no student application at all; awarded by institution from FAFSA data.

name: Dorrance Scholarship
description: A renewable award of $12,000 for first-generation Arizona high school seniors with financial need attending one of the state's public universities.
_quarantineReason: Dorrance Scholarship Program is no longer accepting applications; the program concludes with the class of 2030 (dorrancescholarship.org).

name: Christa McAuliffe Scholarship
description: One-time 500 dollar award for a Tennessee student who aspires to become an exemplary teacher, applied toward an approved teacher-education program at an in-state public or private college. Administered by TSAC.
_quarantineReason: Christa McAuliffe Scholarship terminated effective 2020-07-01; TSAC folded the remaining funds into reserves.

name: UH Manoa Academic Merit Scholarships
description: Merit-based scholarships for incoming first-year students at UH Manoa based on academic achievement. Applicants are typically Hawaii residents seeking a degree.
_quarantineReason: UH Manoa financial aid URL is 404 and no working replacement page was found.

name: VSAC Board of Directors Scholarship (David Coates)
description: For a first-generation Vermont college student pursuing an associate or bachelor's degree in business, accounting, or finance. Administered through the VSAC unified scholarship application.
_quarantineReason: VSAC Board of Directors Scholarship URL is 404 and no working replacement page was found.
